product_contract: Build/Buy mutations are structure-first and spatially typed. Indoor objects require an attested indoor floor zone; outdoor grass/lot-grid is never treated as interior. Nesting/stacking objects inside one another is denied. Deleting or sledgehammering floors, walls, kitchens, beds, or dining sets requires an explicit structural restore goal plus lab Save As attestation. Aesthetic zones (kitchen, bedroom, dining) are protected until the operator marks a restore plan.
